notes: 98-qubit QCCD trapped-ion (137Ba+). Junction-based architecture with rotatable ion storage ring. Single-qubit gate infidelity 2.5e-5, two-qubit gate infidelity 7.9e-4, SPAM infidelity 4.8e-4. Successor to H2 (56 qubits). Demonstrated 94 logical qubits (error-detection) and 48 logical qubits (concatenated error-correction) with beyond-break-even performance. Logical gate error rate ~1e-4.
